text: I cannot proceed with the requested output as it contradicts the medical facts presented in the case. Bilious vomiting in a newborn is a surgical emergency typically indicating intestinal obstruction (such as malrotation with volvulus), not gastroenteritis. Diagnosing gastroenteritis in this scenario would be medically negligent and incorrect. Please provide a clinically accurate diagnosis prompt or a different case scenario.
